City of Encinitas
Planning Commission
AGENDA
FEBRUARY 21, 2019 -
06:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
Items 6A and 8B are located in the Coastal Zone and require the issuance of a Coastal Development Permit (CDP). The action of the Planning Commission relative to Items 6A and 8B may be appealed to the California Coastal Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Planning Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. If at least two (2) Planning Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
5.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act (open meetings for local bodies, California Government Code Section 54950 et seq.).
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Commissioner or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
6A.
PROJECT NAME: Aven Grading; CASE NUMBER: 18-026 DR/CDP; FILING DATE: February 13, 2018; APPLICANT: Ephrayim Aven; LOCATION: 4030 Manchester Avenue (APN 262-061-70); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public hearing for a Design Review Permit and Coastal Development Permit to allow grading for site improvements; ZONING/OVERLAY: The project site is located in the Rural Residential (RR) Zone, Rural Residential Flood Plain (RRFP) zone, Floodplain Overlay (FPO) zone, Scenic/Visual Corridor Overlay (S/VCO) zone, Hillside/Inland Bluff Overlay (H/IBO) zone, and the Coastal Commission Appeal Jurisdiction of the Coastal Zone; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project is exempt from environmental review pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines.
STAFF CONTACT: J. Dichoso, Associate Planner, 760-633-2681, jdichoso@encinitasca.gov
Continue off calendar
Aven Grading Case #18-026 DRCDP
6B.
MEETING CHANGE: Cancelation of the March 7, 2019 Planning Commission meeting
Staff recommends approval.
Cancelation of March 7, 2019 PC Mtg
7.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
8.
REGULAR AGENDA - ACTION ITEMS
8A.
CASE NUMBER: 17-128 GPA/SPA/LCPA; APPLICANT: City of Encinitas; LOCATION: Citywide; DESCRIPTION: An Update to the City’s Housing Element, also known as Housing Plan Update 2019, and Related Land Use Element, Specific Plan, and Zoning Amendments.
Staff recommends the Planning Commission make a recommendation to the City Council to adopt the Housing Element update, along with associated amendments to the General Plan, Zoning Code, Zoning Map, Specific Plans and Local Coastal Program.
Housing Elemnt Update
8B.
PROJECT NAME: Encinitas Arts Culture and Ecology Alliance (EACEA); CASE NUMBER: 17-142 MUP/DR/CDP; FILING DATE: June 13, 2017; APPLICANT: Encinitas Arts Culture and Ecology Alliance; LOCATION: 608 Third Street (APN: 258-151-22-00); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider the proposed redevelopment of a vacant elementary school site into a non-profit arts, ecology and cultural center. ZONING/OVERLAY: The subject property is located in the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan Public/Semi-Public Zone (D-P/SP), and within the Special Study Overlay Zone, and the Coastal Zone; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project is exempt from environmental review pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines;
STAFF CONTACT: Katie Innes, Senior Planner: (760) 633-2716 or kinnes@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends approval.
Encinitas Arts Culture & Ecology Alliance Case #17-142 MUPDRCDP
9.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY PLANNING COMMISSIONERS
10.
PLANNING COMMISSION AND CITY PLANNER REPORTS
11.
ADJOURNMENT Adjourn to the Special Planning Commission meeting of March 14, 2019.
